recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, post-modern composition featuring five stylized, silhouetted figures in dynamic poses, rendered with thick black outlines and filled with eclectic textures, primary colors, and gradients. The figures are arranged horizontally across a light, desaturated background, interspersed with vertical geometric blocks and abstract scribbles.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures interacting with vertical color-gradient columns
Contrast between thick black outlines and thin, chaotic scribbles
Juxtaposition of flat primary colors against soft airbrushed gradients
Balance between a centered horizontal figure row and top/bottom text alignment
coreInvariants: Thick, uniform black outlines for all human silhouettes
Eclectic internal fill patterns (grids, numbers, gradients, flat color)
Light, off-white or pale blue background with subtle vignette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five figures occupy the central horizontal band, scaled to approximately 60% of the canvas height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure with radiating yellow lines serves as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the top display text, down through the sequence of figures from left to right, ending at the bottom subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space at the top and bottom margins to isolate the central action.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background providing a neutral stage.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black outlines defining all primary shapes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant primary red, yellow, and blue used for clothing and hair highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation accents pop against low-saturation background and mid-tone gradients.

letterConstructionRules: Top text uses an open-path, double-line or stencil-like construction
Bottom text is a condensed, italicized sans-serif with rounded terminals
Uniform stroke weight for the top display type
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the top row feature gaps in the strokes to create a technical, futuristic look
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between wide, technical display type and narrow, organic lowercase subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric, technical feel of the top text.
Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a light off-white background with five stylized human silhouettes in a row. Use thick black outlines. Fill silhouettes with a mix of: a blue grid, a vertical teal-to-pink gradient bar, flat primary red, and yellow with red scribbles. Add radiating yellow lines behind the center figure.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide, geometric, stencil-style uppercase text at the top center. Add condensed, italicized lowercase sans-serif text at the bottom center. Ensure all text is black and clean.

verificationChecks: Are the silhouettes outlined in thick black?
Is the top text wide and stencil-like?
Is the bottom text condensed and italicized?
Is there a vertical gradient bar behind one of the figures?

adjustableVariables: Internal fill patterns of the silhouettes
Color of the vertical gradient bar
Width of the top display text
mustRedesign: Exact numerical data in the fill patterns
postGenerationChecks: Check for uniform line weight in figure outlines
Ensure text is perfectly centered horizontally
Verify the presence of the teal-to-pink gradient
Confirm the background remains desaturated and light
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Post-Modern Silhouette Collage] with [Geometric Stencil Display Type] and [Primary Color Accents] on a [Neutral Minimalist Background].
